pricing.rule: Each delivered call bills price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005. A pending/async ack or an unverifiable charged call (delivered:false, refundable:false) bills price_usd × 1.15 with no per-call fee; refunded calls, in-batch duplicates and failed runs bill $0. A call runs only when its full delivered amount fits the batch's remaining max_usd, so max_usd must be at least Σ(price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005).

We’ve literally already seen the correlation play out once.

The crazy part is that most people will probably wait for AGENCY to start pumping again before they realize what’s happening with the coins underneath it. By the time the connection becomes obvious to everyone, the move may already be underway.

I’d rather be positioned before the crowd starts connecting the dots. 🤖📈

We’ve seen it happen before. 👀🔥
